# Vendor

- `astronomy.browser.min.js` — [Astronomy Engine](https://github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy) v2.1.19 (MIT), Don Cross.
- `astronomy-LICENSE.txt` — MIT license text.
- `satellite.min.js` — [satellite.js](https://github.com/shashwatak/satellite-js) v5.0.0 (MIT), SGP4/SDP4 propagator.
- `satellite-LICENSE.txt` — MIT license text.
- `leaflet.js` / `leaflet.css` / `images/` — [Leaflet](https://leafletjs.com/) v1.9.4 (BSD-2-Clause), Volodymyr Agafonkin.
- `leaflet-LICENSE.txt` — BSD-2-Clause license text.

No CDN runtime dependency; files load locally for GitHub Pages.
Map tiles: OpenStreetMap (`tile.openstreetmap.org`) with required attribution; map is created only when the location picker opens.
